An Excellent Helper. So, I reviewed this app a while ago, sometime in August. I am updating from that. I passed the written test 49/50. The question I answered wrongly, I knew but did not read correctly. Anyway, I used this app until the day I had the examination. I studied for an hour, with no practice tests in the beginning. By the time I reached the second section, I had added practice tests. Honestly, I did not use the application’s version, so I used my local DMV’s website. I live in NY, and the questions are nearly identical on the app and website. Every day, I studied, practiced, studied, practiced, etc. Then, when I had the examination, BOOM. I breezed through it. It took me 10-15 minutes, and my brain was on autopilot. Hardly did I look at the questions because I knew the answer already. I never touched the manual, and I hated reading it. None of the information stuck, and people always said, “cram it.” If you are a person that needs an organized and explicit path, this is it. It removes nonessential information so you can study and practice efficiently and effectively. You do not need to view the manual if you bought the subscription for this, and I recommend you do. It costs almost nothing, you have it for life, and it works across all devices. If you want to pass the written exam easily, then this app will help. If you study from this, use practice tests from your local DMV website, it‘s impossible to fail. Thanks to the creators of this app, and I hope everyone can pass their written test with flying colors!

Passed On First Try!. Awesome! Writing this review right after passing the test. I signed up for the test 4 days ago. I then crammed for the test across 6h of learning in this app, spread out across subway rides, queues and waiting for my food. Flash card format helps with quickly absorbing. Instant quiz feedback on whether you’re wrong and the correct explanation is super helpful for retention. Spiral learning pedagogy (quizzes introduce new questions and still test for old questions) ensures that you still retain and refresh the earlier lessons. Handy review section to see which questions you often got wrong. Very limited ads as well, so this review is the least I could do!

 It’s set up like Quizlet Learn function. The great thing about this app is there’s a variety of questions and they are categorized by general knowledge, fines and limits, and signs and situations. The app detects which questions you have been getting wrong in which you can review it in a separate tab in the app. Whether you get the questions wrong or right, an explanation is always provided for every question, which I found extremely helpful to understand. Also, the app can help you set up a study plan which it will tell you how many questions per day you should practice until the day of your test. If you enable the notifications, it will also remind you to study!

On the side note, I passed my permit test with the help of this app! Thanks!
